RACE_MENU_CREATE_DESC: Set a waypoint at least {0} m away, then pick the buy-in. Drivers near you get an invitation.
RACE_MENU_INFO_RUNNING: First at the finish takes the pot
RACE_MENU_CANCEL: Cancel the race (everyone gets the buy-in back)
RACE_MENU_GIVE_UP: Give up (the buy-in stays in the pot)
RACE_CREATED: Race created: {0} drivers nearby were invited, the start is in {1} s. Stay at the start line.
RACE_INVITED: {0} starts a street race, buy-in ${1}. Open the radial menu (Street race) within {2} s to join.
RACE_JOINED: You joined {0}'s street race, pot ${1}. It starts in {2} s, stay at the start line.
RACE_LOST: {0} won the street race and takes ${1}
RACE_TIMEOUT: Nobody reached the finish in time: the pot is split, ${0} each
RACE_LEFT_LOST: You gave up the race, your buy-in stays in the pot
RACE_NOT_READY: You were not at the start line in a vehicle: out of the race, ${0} back
RACE_CANCELLED_HOST: The host cancelled the street race, ${0} back
RACE_CANCELLED_EMPTY: Not enough racers: the street race is off, ${0} back
RACE_CANCELLED_STOP: Street races were stopped by the server, ${0} back
RACE_ERR_WAYPOINT: Set a waypoint on the map first: it is the finish
RACE_ERR_MONEY: You do not have enough money for the buy-in
RACE_ERR_ALREADY: You are already in a race
RACE_ERR_CLOSED: This race no longer takes racers
RACE_ERR_INVITE: You were not invited to this race
RACE_ERR_FAR: Drive to the start line first
RACE_ERR_HOST: Only the host can start the race before the time is up
RACE_ERR_ALONE: Wait for at least one more racer
RACE_ERR_NONE: You are not in a race
ALERT_MESSAGE: {0} vehicles lining up for an illegal race
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Buy-ins, join time, racers and police alerts of player street races.
ADMIN_C_MONEY_DESC: Racers pay the buy-in when they join; the first at the finish takes every buy-in.
ADMIN_H_ACCOUNT: The account buy-ins are taken from and prizes and refunds are paid to.
ADMIN_H_MIN_BUYIN: The smallest buy-in a player may set; 0 allows free races.
ADMIN_H_MAX_BUYIN: The largest buy-in a player may set; not below the lowest buy-in.
ADMIN_ERR_BUYIN_RANGE: The highest buy-in cannot be below the lowest buy-in
ADMIN_C_RACES_DESC: Applies to races created after a change.
ADMIN_H_JOIN_TIME: How long invited drivers have to join; the host can start earlier. A 5 second countdown follows.
ADMIN_H_MAX_RACERS: The most racers one race takes, the host included.
ADMIN_H_INVITE_RADIUS: Drivers this close to the host get the invitation; racers must stay this close (plus 25 m) to the start.
ADMIN_H_MIN_DISTANCE: The straight-line distance from the start to the waypoint must be at least this.
ADMIN_H_MAX_TIME: A race nobody finishes in this time ends and the pot is split between the racers still in it.
ADMIN_C_POLICE_DESC: Alerts go through the alert system ai-core uses.
ADMIN_H_ALERT_CHANCE: The chance that a race start sends a police alert at the start line; 0 never alerts.
COMMAND_RACE_HELP: Open the street race menu (create, join, start, leave)
